# `non-idiomatic-file-name`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: official · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a Zig source filename whose casing does not match the kind of
declaration it represents.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Consistent file and declaration naming makes imports predictable and navigation
faster.

## When it fires

It applies when the file has a clear primary type or module role; ambiguous
multi-purpose files are not forced into a pattern.
